focus_areas: Fur texture realism vs. AI smoothing/plasticity
Boundary integrity between adult and juvenile (limb fusion)
Species identification via visible markings despite facial occlusion
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plastic' sheen on the adult's fur in the highlighted regions. Investigate whether the lack of detail in the juvenile's face is consistent with optical blur or generative smoothing. Verify if the gripping posture of the juvenile is physically plausible or if limbs merge into the adult's body, using the segmentation masks provided by the topology auditor. Consider how the open-vocabulary detector's findings on fur patterns support the species classification despite the obscured face.
image_description: A high-contrast, close-up image of an adult guenon monkey carrying a juvenile on its chest. The lighting is dramatic, creating strong highlights on the fur and deep shadows that obscure parts of the face and body. The adult's head is turned slightly, showing a dark face with lighter fur around it (ruff). The juvenile is nestled against the adult, looking forward with visible eyes. The background is blurred and indistinct.
